// diagnostic

E0204

Same value used while `mut` is active in one call

What

Same value used while `mut` is active in one call

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

End the active `mut` borrow before using the value again.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0204: tests/ui/E0204_call_arg_lent_and_moved.stderr.

Error [jet.UseWhileWriteActive]: `t` is already lent to this call, so `pair` can't take it here too
  --> tests/ui/E0204_call_arg_lent_and_moved.jet:7:19
    |
  7 |     print(pair(t, t))
    |                   ^
 Why: An earlier argument lets `pair` read `t` for the whole call, so this argument can't hand the same value over
 Fix: Pass a copy to one of the two parameters with `t.copy()`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0204
